display_long_description:
# Experience the golden age of Islam in Virtual Reality!
Immerse yourself in the vibrant historical Medina and join Osman, Zubeyr and other characters on an unforgettable journey. **Get to know the Sahaba** – the companions of the Prophet (pbuh)– and learn about their way of life, their values and their daily routines.
[media]
# Your Adventure
Your adventure begins at the city gate, where you receive a warm welcome. Soon your first task awaits: Help Osman prepare his caravan and load heavy sacks onto the patient camels. Then Zubeyr challenges you to an exciting horse race – do you have what it takes to win? Stroll through the bustling market, watch the merchants at work and discover the variety of goods. When the call of the Muezzin rises, follow the faithful to the majestic Mosque of the Prophet(pbuh) and experience a moment of peace and reflection.
[media]

# Why This Game?
**A unique experience** to get to know the Sahaba in an innovative way and take them as role models. Transform your knowledge from books into a living adventure with the great heroes of Islamic history.
[media]
